name: lru_cache
description: A least-recently-used cache with hit/miss/eviction statistics, pop, resize and a memoize helper.
bugs: _touch() only appends unseen keys, so get/put never move an existing key to most-recent
put() evicts whenever the cache is full, even when only updating an existing key
pop() removes the value but leaves the key in the recency list, corrupting later evictions
